name: Alfaxalone
summary: Alfaxalone, also known as alphaxalone or alphaxolone and sold under the brand name Alfaxan and Faxone, is a neuroactive steroid and general anesthetic which is used currently in veterinary practice as an induction agent for anesthesia and as an injectable anesthetic.

pharmacology.text: Alfaxalone is a neuroactive steroid derived from progesterone, though it has no glucocorticoid or mineralocorticoid action. Instead, it works by acting on GABAA receptors. It binds to the M3/M4 domains of the α subunit and allosterically modifies the receptor to facilitate the movement of chloride ions into the cell, resulting in hyperpolarization of the post-synaptic nerve (which inhibits actions potentials).

uses.text: Alfaxalone, also known as alphaxalone or alphaxolone and sold under the brand name Alfaxan and Faxone, is a neuroactive steroid and general anesthetic which is used currently in veterinary practice as an induction agent for anesthesia and as an injectable anesthetic.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effect of alfaxalone is respiratory depression: in addition to apnea, the most prevalent, alfaxalone can also decrease the respiratory rate, minute volume, and oxygen saturation in the blood. Alfaxalone should be administered slowly over a period of at least 60 seconds or until anesthesia is induced, as quick administration increases the risk of apnea.

fact.en: After Althesin was withdrawn, alfaxalone returned in a new form, dissolved with the help of a ring-shaped sugar molecule called a cyclodextrin. It is now widely used to anaesthetise cats and dogs.
fact.zh: Althesin 下市後，Alfaxalone 以新的配方重新登場，藉助一種叫環糊精的環狀糖分子溶解。如今它廣泛用於貓狗的麻醉。
fact.zhHans: Althesin 下市后，Alfaxalone 以新的配方重新登场，借助一种叫环糊精的环状糖分子溶解。如今它广泛用于猫狗的麻醉。
